title: Rotate Image
prompt:
Rotate an `n x n` matrix 90° clockwise, **in place** (no second matrix).

**Example**: `[[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7,8,9]]` → `[[7,4,1],[8,5,2],[9,6,3]]`.

Transpose, then reverse each row — from the pattern lesson.
hints: Transpose: swap matrix[i][j] with matrix[j][i] for j > i only (upper triangle).
Then reverse every row with two pointers.

solution.explanation: Clockwise rotation sends row i to column n-1-i; transpose (rows↔columns) followed by row reversal composes to exactly that. O(n²) time, O(1) space, and no fiddly four-way cycle swaps to get wrong.
